claims.title: Calibrated spectral moments and positive operator transport pay specific noncommutative coherence budgets

quoted_fields.interface: Rank-one lower source for the calibrated coherence theorem; actual spectral weights, including a missing zero atom, satisfy both exact mean and reciprocal moments. The operator theorem instead requires the explicit Loewner resource cap, faithful environmental V for the block pencil and actual Schur normalization. Binary balanced entropy transfer uses N993's compatible two-source interface.
quoted_fields.failure: Arbitrary PSD noise does not remove the rank-one source restriction. The operator integral theorem is higher rank but equal trace alone does not imply its operator cap; nonflat sources and general singular/faithful active-cap endpoints remain outside the receiver. Mathematical filters may be noncontractive positive congruences, not physical operations. Scalar transport sign proof covers beta>=4; failure of that proof below4 is not a counterexample. The unrestricted coherent WH3 target remains open.

claims.title: WH3 entropy receivers cover specific spectral and support classes while forbidding free pinching

quoted_fields.interface: The actual W3 channel and conditional expectation. Spectral classes refer to the actual product support; modular commutation must be with the input's own marginal. The correlated-support theorem requires a matched orthonormal physical/reference basis and its audited anchored-source envelope.
quoted_fields.failure: Two positive spectral levels plus an additional nonproduct kernel may have three levels and are outside aI+bP. Purification duality is a special exact identity, not monotonicity under discarding a reference. The exact marginal-pinching example locally lowers Delta when coherence is added, defeating free pinching but not producing a WH3 counterexample. General three-or-more-level nonaligned inputs remain open. No physical decoder, acquisition, capacity advantage or full target claim.
